pill.desc: white lyophilized powder in a single-dose vial

tell: A chimeric antibody with murine variable regions, so a previous severe reaction to any murine protein is a contraindication.

clues.text: The drug is distributed primarily within the vascular compartment. Clearance rises once antibodies to it develop.
Expressed in a recombinant murine myeloma cell line, SP2/0, with a molecular weight of about 149.1 kilodaltons; supplied as a sterile, preservative-free lyophilized powder.
A BLA product in 100 mg single-dose vials, dosed at weeks 0, 2 and 6 and then every 8 weeks.

Boxed warning for serious infections, including tuberculosis, and malignancy. Contraindicated after a severe hypersensitivity reaction to the drug or murine proteins; infusion reactions and headache are common.
Listed first is Crohn's disease in adults and in children from 6 years of age, including fistulizing disease in adults.
Binds TNF-alpha in soluble and transmembrane forms with high affinity, blocking its receptor binding. It does not neutralize lymphotoxin-alpha.
The generic name begins with I and has ten letters.
